#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <stdexcept>

using namespace std;

class RMQ {
public:
    int n, k;
    vector<vector<int>> minTable;

    RMQ(vector<int>& a) {
        n = a.size();
        if (n == 0) {
            k = 0;
            return;
        }
        k = 0;
        int x = n;
        while (x > 0) {
            x >>= 1;
            k++;
        }
        minTable.resize(k, vector<int>(n, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            minTable[0][i] = a[i];
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j + (1 << (i - 1)) < n; j++) {
                minTable[i][j] = min(minTable[i-1][j], minTable[i-1][j + (1 << (i - 1))]);
            }
        }
    }

    int query(int a, int b) {
        if (a > b) return INT_MAX;
        int len = b - a + 1;
        int z = 0;
        int temp = len;
        while (temp > 1) {
            temp >>= 1;
            z++;
        }
        return min(minTable[z][a], minTable[z][b - (1 << z) + 1]);
    }
};

struct FastScanner {
    FILE* stream;
    
    FastScanner(FILE* s) : stream(s) {}
    
    int readChar() {
        return fgetc(stream);
    }
    
    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == EOF;
    }
    
    bool isEndline(int c) {
        return c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == EOF;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        int c = readChar();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) c = readChar();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = readChar();
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (!isSpaceChar(c)) {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("Invalid input");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = readChar();
        }
        return res * sign;
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, k;
    scanf("%d %d", &n, &k);
    
    vector<vector<int>> segs(k, vector<int>(2));
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        scanf("%d %d", &segs[i][0], &segs[i][1]);
    }
    
    sort(segs.begin(), segs.end(), [](const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b) {
        return a[0] < b[0];
    });
    
    vector<vector<int>> finSeg;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ) {
        int lo = segs[i][0];
        int hi = segs[i][0];
        while (i < k && segs[i][0] <= hi) {
            hi = max(hi, segs[i][1]);
            i++;
        }
        finSeg.push_back({lo, hi});
        i--;
        i++;
    }
    
    k = finSeg.size();
    segs = finSeg;
    
    vector<int> l(k), delt(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        l[i] = segs[i][1] - segs[i][0];
        delt[i] = (i < k - 1) ? (segs[i+1][0] - segs[i][1]) : (2 * n - segs[i][1]);
    }
    
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(2, vector<vector<int>>(k + 1, vector<int>(2 * n + 1, 0)));
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * n + 1; i++) {
        dp[0][k][i] = n;
        dp[1][k][i] = n;
    }
    dp[0][k][n] = 0;
    dp[1][k][n] = 0;
    
    vector<RMQ> rmq(2);
    rmq[0] = RMQ(dp[0][k]);
    rmq[1] = RMQ(dp[1][k]);
    
    for (int i = k - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * n; j++) {
            dp[0][i][j] = (j + l[i] + delt[i] <= 2 * n) ? dp[0][i+1][j + l[i] + delt[i]] : n;
            dp[1][i][j] = dp[1][i+1][j];
            
            int val1 = rmq[1].query(j, min(j + l[i], 2 * n));
            dp[0][i][j] = min(dp[0][i][j], 1 + val1);
            
            if (j + delt[i] <= 2 * n) {
                int val2 = rmq[0].query(j + delt[i], min(j + l[i] + delt[i], 2 * n));
                dp[1][i][j] = min(dp[1][i][j], 1 + val2);
                dp[0][i][j] = min(dp[0][i][j], 2 + val2);
            }
            
            int val3 = rmq[1].query(j, min(j + l[i], 2 * n));
            dp[1][i][j] = min(dp[1][i][j], 2 + val3);
        }
        rmq[0] = RMQ(dp[0][i]);
        rmq[1] = RMQ(dp[1][i]);
    }
    
    int ans = dp[1][0][0];
    if (ans == n) {
        printf("Hungry\n");
    } else {
        printf("Full\n");
        printf("%d\n", ans);
    }
    
    return 0;
}
